"""Probe: what can a .prototypes script import here?"""

report = []

try:
    import importlib

    mod = importlib.import_module("text_classification.memory_system")
    report.append(("text_classification.memory_system", "OK"))
except Exception as exc:
    report.append(("text_classification.memory_system", f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"))

try:
    import importlib

    mod = importlib.import_module("text_classification.agents.confusion_disambiguation_memory")
    report.append(("agents.confusion_disambiguation_memory", "OK"))
except Exception as exc:
    report.append(("agents.confusion_disambiguation_memory", f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"))

for name, status in report:
    print(f"{name}: {status}")
